Clicking the square: the square became W-border/p-center (like the white dot), the white dot was consumed, and a new 20px p-border/M-center "ball" appeared at (53,22) — the midpoint between the square and the gray dot. So the active ball (p/M) advanced one half-step toward the gray dot.
Hypothesis: clicking the ball advances it along the line toward the next node; the hollow ring at (21,39) is the final goal. Step counter (white frame) = 64 − actions, so ~61 moves remain.
Plan: click the ball at (53,22) to see if it advances toward the gray dot.
